question: **Select the sentences that contains no spelling errors.**

options.text: He screeched hystericalli after seeing the accident.
He screeched hystericaly after seeing the accident.
He screeched hysteerically after seeing the accident.
He screeched hysterically after seeing the accident.

solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., "hysterically."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

 
• The correct spelling is 'hysterically.'
 
• 'hysterically' means 'without being able to control your feelings or behaviour because you are extremely frightened, angry, excited, etc.' (अपनी भावनाओं या व्यवहार को नियंत्रित करने में सक्षम हुए बिना क्योंकि आप अत्यधिक भयभीत, क्रोधित, उत्तेजित आदि हैं)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *He held her to him and she started to weep **hysterically.***
 
 
 
• Therefore, option 4 is the correct answer.​
